purpose: Export the unchanged trained V0 and development-selected V1 for a later matched ONNX Runtime CPU iPhone benchmark, before considering V2.

versions.V1: Matched 2-6m continuation control, block 5; NOT the six-cell candidate
versions.V2: Not trained or implemented by this workflow

test_suites.scope: Local regression/unit tests. Includes real small two-input ONNX roundtrip and synthetic end-to-end package/transfer tests, not a completed Colab export qualification.

real_mac_host_diagnostic.root_cause_of_mac_linux_native_discrepan: Not established. Native Mac inference itself differs from the saved Linux endpoint; ONNX closely matches native Mac inference. Matching Torch 2.11.0 did not remove the discrepancy. Do not attribute it to ONNX or a model weight change.
real_mac_host_diagnostic.production_gate_action: Stop before deployment packaging. Do not relax tolerances, replace the reviewed metrics, refit scale, retrain or change weights to conceal the discrepancy.

workflow_contract.runtime: CPU-only Colab, task-local pinned packages; no CUDA extension or M67 environment
workflow_contract.input_handling: Two authenticated ZIPs staged once locally. Inference never reads hundreds of mounted-Drive image files.
workflow_contract.resume: Complete graph and per-shard comparison artifacts are verified/reused on the same VM/code/runtime. Partial shard restarts. No automatic cross-VM resume claim.
workflow_contract.gate: All512 frozen dev images: dense outputs, reviewed point predictions, coverage/denominators, per-class/range MAE and primary MAE must pass unchanged numerical tolerances.
workflow_contract.phone_package: Only after every gate passes: two graphs, 16 metadata-selected full-output runtime fixtures, and all512 losslessly stored preprocessed FP32 inputs with exact camera/grid/GT owner/mask arrays and native depth references.
workflow_contract.scope: Sparse conservative object-owned camera-axis Z in metres, not detector mAP/recall, dense GT, metric 3D-cuboid accuracy or ultrasonic nearest-surface range.

next_step: Publish after approval, then run the CPU-only notebook in Colab against the unchanged frozen Linux endpoints. Review parking_v0_v1_onnx_results.zip before integrating V0/V1 into the existing app.
